target_customer: Electrical engineers and hardware teams designing printed circuit boards
problem: PCB design is slow and error-prone. Resin adds AI to design research, schematic generation, symbol and footprint creation and routing.
product_category: AI-native ECAD and PCB design tool

founders.name: Anmol Jawandha
prior_employers: you.com (led the forward deployed engineering team, per launch post)

founders.name: Koosha Rezaiezadeh
founders.background_notes: YC page lists an IPHO gold medal and nuclear physics research.

competitors.name: Quilter
competitors.what: Physics-driven AI PCB layout on top of existing CAD
competitors.funding_then: $25M Series B led by Index Ventures, per Quilter's own blog

competitors.name: Diode Computers
competitors.what: AI-powered PCB design and manufacturing, YC S24

technical_complexity.rationale: A full ECAD tool with schematic, layout, routing, BOM, manufacturing export and KiCad and Altium import plus AI generation is a large engineering scope for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Design files and library workflows lock users in, but Flux, Quilter and Diode raised tens of millions and Altium, Cadence and KiCad hold the installed base.

market_need_then: Several well-funded AI PCB tools launched through 2026, showing buyers and investors expect AI to reshape ECAD.

branding.domain_note: Uses resineda.com, not an exact .com for the name.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and product-focused with the line Unleash your ambition

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found; searches for the brand returned only unrelated resin chemical companies, so the name is hard to find.

outcome_analysis: Resin is a Fall 2026 AI PCB design tool entering a market where Flux, Quilter and Diode had already raised significant rounds. The founders have hardware and AI backgrounds, but no outcome exists yet and the generic name competes with resin chemistry in search.
notes: Funding searches found no coverage; site says only Backed by Y Combinator. Team size listed 0 in dataset.
